title: Optimil Machinery
description:
Optimil Machinery Inc. is a globally recognized leader in primary and secondary log processing 
machinery, specializing in log and board optimization systems for sawmills. The company focuses
on designing and manufacturing high-quality sawmill machinery, providing innovative solutions 
to enhance production efficiency and maximize wood resource utilization.
